ema_initialization: clone the randomly initialized actor including buffers, before update 1
evaluation_interruption: discard unfinished training episodes without sampler feedback, restore raw actor and RNG, reset before next rollout
evaluation_strata: near distance bands 0-2, 2-5, 5-10 cm; other regions low/mid/high height

classification.last500_rising: EMA near overall at 1000,1100,1200,1300,1400,1500: positive OLS slope AND last-three mean greater than first-three mean
classification.priority: Use R0 if it passes, regardless of R1; consider R1 only if R0 does not pass
